free_tier: Hosted open models (gpt-oss-120b/20b, Qwen family, Whisper) via an OpenAI-compatible API
limits: About 30 RPM, 1,000 requests/day, 200K tokens/day per model on gpt-oss; limits apply per organization, not per key
catch: Token-per-day ceiling usually binds before the request count does

free_tier: Flash / Flash-Lite models and Gemma via Google AI Studio, rate-limited
limits: Google no longer publishes fixed per-model free limits; check AI Studio for your account
catch: Free-tier content may be used to improve Google products (not in EEA/UK/CH)

free_tier: Free inference endpoints for selected preview models on build.nvidia.com
limits: Reported around 40 RPM; no published SLA
catch: Requires a verified NVIDIA Developer Program account; published limits are thin

free_tier: Free plan with monthly API credit (previously listed as $10/month) plus Studio
limits: Shared monthly allowance across Studio, API and Vibe; exact amount no longer stated on the pricing page as of 2026-10-07
catch: Free-mode prompts may be used for training unless you opt out

free_tier: Hosted open models (Llama, gpt-oss) on Workers AI
catch: Not OpenAI-style: uses its own /ai/run endpoint shape

free_tier: Trial key for Command / Aya models
catch: Trial key is non-commercial use only

free_tier: RETIRED on 2026-07-30. There is no free tier anymore.
catch: Do not build anything new on it; older blog posts still recommend it
